description: Prime Studios read-only diagnostics: runs one named check from scripts/diagnostics/on-box.sh, taken from a commit on origin/main, as ubuntu. Changes nothing.

check.description: One check from the fixed list

runCommand: sudo -u ubuntu -H bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; cd /home/ubuntu/episode-metadata; git fetch --quiet origin main || echo "note: git fetch failed; using the last fetched origin/main"; git merge-base --is-ancestor {{ sha }} origin/main; d=$(mktemp -d); trap "rm -rf $d" EXIT; git archive {{ sha }} scripts/diagnostics | tar -x -C "$d"; bash "$d/scripts/diagnostics/on-box.sh" {{ check }} {{ sha }}'
